about_the_game:
"Zhu Xian Sword Array" is a simulation management game full of the warmth of daily life, taking you to experience the town life and industrial development immersively.

In the game, you can take care of the warm main house area. It is decorated with a strong sense of daily life, and you can also run different shops, such as stalls selling special foods, to meet the needs of the town's residents and visiting guests. At the same time, you can also plan the freight station to ensure smooth cargo transportation and boost the town's trade.

Outdoors, you can reclaim land and plant various crops, watching them grow slowly from seeds. You can also create exclusive breeding areas to raise poultry and livestock. By the waterside, you can carry out fishery-related operations, drive a small boat to work on the water, and harvest abundant aquatic products.

From basic life and production to the gradual expansion of industries, you will build your own town step by step in "Zhu Xian Sword Array" and feel the joy and achievement of management.
